m_moon_reg: 15 m. Below the dust: rock shattered by four billion years of impacts.
m_moon_crust: 2 km. The pale crust that makes the Moon shine.
m_moon_mantle: 50 km. Through the lunar crust. One sixth of the gravity, the same digging.
m_moon_core: 1,400 km. The Moon has a tiny iron core after all.
m_moon_center: 1,737 km. THE CENTER OF THE MOON. Now up to the far side, which no one on Earth ever sees.
m_mars_ice: 20 m. Permafrost. There is more water on Mars than people think.
m_mars_basalt: 500 m. Old volcanic rock. Mars had lava once.
m_mars_olympus: 21.9 km. Olympus Mons, the tallest volcano in the Solar System, would fit in your hole.
m_mars_mantle: 50 km. The crust of Mars is thicker than Earth's. You are through it.
m_mars_center: 3,390 km. THE CENTER OF MARS. Halfway. Dig up!
m_venus_plains: 10 m. Surface: 465 °C and 90 atmospheres. Your shovel is melting slightly.
m_venus_crust: 500 m. Young basalt. Venus resurfaced itself with lava not long ago.
m_venus_mantle: 60 km. Through the crust of Earth's evil twin.
m_venus_core: 3,000 km. The core of Venus. Probably liquid. Nobody knows for sure.
m_venus_center: 6,052 km. THE CENTER OF VENUS. Halfway.
m_nep_wind: 1 km. Wind at 2,000 km/h, the fastest in the Solar System.
m_nep_ice: 5,000 km. The ice mantle: hot, dense water and ammonia, not snow.
m_nep_diamond: 10,000 km. It literally rains diamonds here.
m_nep_core: 20,000 km. A rocky core the size of the Earth.
m_nep_center: 24,622 km. THE CENTER OF NEPTUNE. Halfway.
m_jup_storm: 50 km. The Great Red Spot: a storm bigger than Earth, raging for centuries.
m_jup_ocean: 1,000 km. No surface. The gas just becomes liquid.
m_jup_metal: 20,000 km. Metallic hydrogen: pressure so high hydrogen behaves like a metal.
m_jup_core: 60,000 km. A fuzzy core, 25 times the mass of Earth.
m_jup_center: 69,911 km. THE CENTER OF JUPITER. Halfway. Up through the other side.
m_sun_photo: 500 km. Through the photosphere, the layer that makes daylight.
m_sun_convect: 200,000 km. The convection zone: plasma boiling like a pot.
m_sun_core: 500,000 km. The core. 15 million degrees. Fusion.
m_sun_center: 696,000 km. THE CENTER OF THE SUN. Nothing is deeper. Halfway up to the far side.
